explanation: A different claim from the one above it, and worth keeping apart from it. That edge says abolition was the trigger; this one says what the Empire was standing on. The political base of the monarchy was a slaveholding agrarian elite, and that class is the traffic’s product: it existed in that form, on that scale, because five and a half million people had been landed to work for it. The Republic of 1889 is the political form that followed the removal of that base, which is a statement about 1540 as much as about 1888.
